comment: Methylates C-3 of 5-guanidino-2-oxopentanoate (the α-keto acid of arginine); the product is transaminated by ArgM to (2S,3R)-β-methylarginine, a residue of the peptidyl nucleoside antibiotic arginomycin. ArgM also forms the ArgN substrate from L-arginine.

reactions.description: C-methylation of C-3 of 5-guanidino-2-oxopentanoate to give (3R)-5-guanidino-3-methyl-2-oxopentanoate
the product is transaminated by ArgM (L-aspartate as amino donor) to (2S,3R)-β-methylarginine and incorporated into arginomycin
